mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 47 degrees with overcast skies near Reddan Soccer Park. The full moon is out, and although the ISS will pass overhead tonight, it will not be visible due to the cloud cover.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation is holding public meetings for the US 18/151 Corridor Study to gather feedback on initial design concepts. You can attend in person at Mount Horeb High School on November 18 or join virtually on November 19.

We have plenty of fun ahead. Today features trivia at both Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, more trivia at The Bogey Factory, or pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.
In a report from October 25, officers found a man passed out behind the wheel at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
